name: chibi-pets
description: Chibi super-deformed Roblox pet toy style for Drive A Car Simulator. Oversized head, stubby limbs, vibrant toy-like appearance. Matches PermanentDesignSpecs.md exactly.
hunyuan_prompt_modifiers: ONE SINGLE adorable chibi super-deformed Roblox collectible pet toy figure, oversized head (40-50% of body), very stubby short limbs, T-pose, Funko Pop or Pet Simulator X style, vibrant saturated colors, smooth toy-like surfaces, pure white background, product photography lighting, front three-quarter view
negative_prompt: realistic, full body proportions, tall, lanky, weapons, text, logos
roblox_rules: Use with PetAnimator.luau and PetController.luau. Follow rarity color system and PermanentDesignSpecs.md
